title: 53 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Making Plans)
description:
Learn 53 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 53 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Making Plans · 制定计划
1:30  Travel & Airport · 旅行与机场
2:42  Positive Life · 积极人生

PHRASE LIST

MAKING PLANS · 制定计划
• Let’s pick a start date. - 我们选个开始日期吧。  [Wǒmen xuǎn ge kāishǐ rìqī ba.]
• I’ll send you the draft plan. - 我把计划草案发你。  [Wǒ bǎ jìhuà cǎoàn fā nǐ.]
• What’s your preferred pace? - 你想按什么节奏来？  [Nǐ xiǎng àn shénme jiézòu lái?]
• We’ll decide priorities first. - 我们先排个优先级。  [Wǒmen xiān pái gè yōuxiān jí.]
• Let’s reserve time for buffer. - 我们留点弹性时间。  [Wǒmen liú diǎn dànxìng shíjiān.]
• Can we plan around your busy days? - 我们能不能避开你最忙的日子？  [Wǒmen néng bù néng bìkāi nǐ zuì máng de rìzi?]
• I’ll check what we already have. - 我先确认一下我们有什么资源。  [Wǒ xiān quèrèn yíxià wǒmen yǒu shénme zīyuán.]

TRAVEL & AIRPORT · 旅行与机场
• Where can I check in - 请问哪里可以值机，  [Qǐng wèn nǎlǐ kěyǐ zhí jī, PLEASE]
• I need a paper boarding pass - 我可以拿纸质登机牌吗，  [Wǒ kěyǐ ná zhǐzhì dēng jī pái ma,]
• Is there a baggage cart nearby - 附近有手推行李车吗，  [Fùjìn yǒu shǒutuī xínglǐ chē ma,]
• Can I pay by card here - 这里可以刷卡吗，  [Zhèlǐ kěyǐ shuā kǎ ma,]
• What time does boarding start - 登机大概几点开始，  [Dēng jī dàgài jǐdiǎn kāishǐ,]
• My seat is next to the aisle - 我选的是靠走道的座位，  [Wǒ xuǎn de shì kào zǒudào de zuòwèi,]

POSITIVE LIFE · 积极人生
• You’ve got this, calmly. - 你会做到的，心里稳一点。  [Nǐ huì zuò dào de, Xīn lǐ wěn yìdiǎn.]
• Start now, not someday. - 从现在开始，不等到以后。  [Cóng xiànzài kāishǐ, bù děng dào yǐhòu.]
• Move your body, lift your mood. - 动一动，心情就会更亮。  [Dòng yì dòng, xīnqíng jiù huì gèng liàng.]
• Let your gratitude lead. - 把感恩放在前面。  [Bǎ gǎn'ēn fàng zài qiánmiàn.]
• Protect your focus, gently. - 温柔守住你的注意力。  [Wēnróu shǒu zhù nǐ de zhùyì lì.]
• Speak to yourself with respect. - 对自己说话要有分寸。  [Duì zìjǐ shuōhuà yào yǒu fēnchùn.]
• Make peace with imperfect days. - 不完美的日子也算日子。  [Bù wánměi de rìzi yě suàn rìzi.]

CELEBRATIONS & PARTIES · 庆祝活动与派对
• Cheers to our team tonight! - 今晚为我们的团队干杯！  [Jin WAN wei wo MEN de tuan DUI GAN BEI!]
• I brought a cake, for you. - 我给你带了蛋糕。  [Wo gei ni dai le DAN GAO.]
• Can I help set up? - 我可以帮忙布置吗？  [Wo ke yi bang MANG bu ZHI ma?]
• Where do we put gifts? - 礼物放哪里呀？  [Li wu fang na li ya?]
• Let’s take photos together now. - 我们现在一起拍照吧。  [Wo MEN xian zai yi qi pai ZHAO ba.]
• Play whatever music you like! - 你想放什么歌就放什么。  [Ni xiang fang shen me ge jiu fang shen me.]
• I’m on my way, five minutes. - 我马上到了，五分钟后见。  [Wo ma shang dao le, wu fen zhong hou jian.]

ORDERING FOOD & DINING · 点餐与用餐
• I’ll take this set meal, please. - 我要这个套餐，谢谢。  [Wo YAO zhe GE TAO CAN, XIE XIE.]
• Can we get takeaway boxes? - 可以打包吗？  [KE yi DA BAO ma?]
• Do you have table service? - 你们是送到桌上吗？  [NI men shi SOng dao ZHUO shang ma?]
• Can I pay with WeChat? - 我可以用微信付款吗？  [Wo ke yi YONG WEI xin FU KUAN ma?]
• Do you accept cards? - 可以刷卡吗？  [KE yi SHUA ka ma?]
• I’d like the chef’s special. - 我要点主厨推荐。  [Wo YAO dian ZHU CHU TUI JIAN.]
• Any seasonal dishes today? - 今天有什么时令菜吗？  [Jin tian you SHEN me SHI ling cai ma?]

AGREEING & DISAGREEING · 同意与反对
• Absolutely, I back that idea. - 我完全同意你的想法。  [Wǒ quán bù tóng yì nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.]
• I’m on board, no problem. - 我赞成，没问题。  [Wǒ zàn chéng, méi wèn tí.]
• That works for me, sure. - 这个我可以接受。  [Zhè ge wǒ kě yǐ jiē shòu.]
• You make a strong case. - 你说得很有道理。  [Nǐ shuō de hěn yǒu dào lǐ.]
• Let’s do it that way. - 我们就按这个来吧。  [Wǒ men jiù àn zhè ge lái ba.]
• I agree, but we should adjust. - 我同意，不过我们得做点调整。  [Wǒ tóng yì, bú guò wǒ men děi zuò diǎn tiáo zhěng.]
• I can’t agree with that. - 我不同意你的说法。  [Wǒ bù tóng yì nǐ de shuō fǎ.]

MOTIVATION · 动力
• Motivation, even on tired days - 动力也要带上疲惫的日子  [dòng LÌ yě yào dài shàng pÍ bèi de rì zi]
• Make it fun, then make it work - 先让它好玩，再让它变成习惯  [xiān ràng tā hǎo wán, zài ràng tā biàn chéng xí guàn]
• Choose one win for today - 今天就定一个小胜利  [jīn tiān jiù dìng yí gè xiǎo shèng lì]
• Turn boring practice into momentum - 把无聊练习变成连续的动力  [bǎ wú liáo liàn xí biàn chéng lián xù de dòng lì]
• Do one conversation, get energized - 跟人聊两句, 你的动力就回来了  [gēn rén liáo liǎng jù, nǐ de dòng lì jiù huí lái le]
• Let progress motivate your next step - 你看到一点进步, 就更想继续  [nǐ kàn dào yì diǎn jìn bù, jiù gèng xiǎng jì xù]

CONFIDENCE · 自信
• I can learn this in public - 我可以当着大家学  [Wǒ kěyǐ dāngzhe dàjiā xué]
